content: We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We need the molecule; not given directly. We have tools to get spectra: carbon NMR, proton NMR, HSQC, IR. Carbonyl groups can be identified via IR (strong C=O stretch ~1700 cm-1) or carbon NMR (carbonyl carbon ~190-220 ppm). We need count. Likely easiest: get IR spectrum and count number of distinct carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool.
